title: Fractured Celluloid
description: A woman with three faces stands in a decaying, cracked room holding a film reel. Film strips, broken frames, and a large mirror reflecting a shadowy silhouette fill the dilapidated space illuminated by a dramatic purple beam of light from above.
prompt: A surreal scene of a woman with three overlapping faces wearing a dark satin gown, standing in a dilapidated ornate room with cracked peeling walls and ceiling. She holds a large film reel as film strips spill across the floor among broken picture frames. A tall mirror reflects only a dark silhouette. Dramatic purple light beam cuts through the darkness. Scattered film canisters, photographs on walls, classical statue fragment. Moody, cinematic surrealism, detailed textures.
